how.title: Three steps. No hassle.
how.subtitle: A simple cycle that keeps objects moving and the community in balance.
how.step1_title: Post what you want to give away
how.step1_body: Take a photo and describe the item you no longer need. It becomes available to people within 50 km. Up to 5 photos per item.

system.label: The community
system.subtitle: Behavior shapes opportunities. Those who give receive more easily. Those who don't show up appear lower on the list.
system.value1_body: No item has a price. There are no financial transactions here. What you donate, you give away — no exceptions.
system.value2_body: Your delivery history sets your place on the candidate list. When you take part and show up, you move up. If you don't show up, you move down the list.
system.value3_body: Objects circulate locally. Less footprint, more real community. You only see items that are close to you.
system.value4_body: No internal chat. Contact details are only shared when the donor confirms the handoff. Automatically purged after 7 days.

meta.description: A community platform where objects find new hands. Access depends on your community behavior, not your wallet.

faq.a1: Regálalo is a community where you can give away objects you no longer use and receive what others offer, all without money. The more you participate and contribute, the easier it is to be chosen when you request something. It's not about what's in your wallet, but what you give back.
faq.a2: You post items you want to give away, request items near you (up to 3 per month), and the donor chooses who to give them to — usually prioritising whoever has contributed most to the community and lives closest. Handoffs happen in person.
faq.a3: Yes. There are no prices or financial transactions. You only need an email and postal code to join.
faq.q4: Which cities is Regálalo available in?
faq.a4: Regálalo is available throughout Spain. Items are distributed within a 50 km radius, so anyone with a Spanish postal code can participate.
faq.q5: How is Regálalo different from other second-hand platforms?
faq.a5: Regálalo has no money. You cannot sell or buy: only give and receive. Unlike other platforms where price is everything, here what determines who gets an item is how much you've contributed to the community, not what you're willing to pay.
faq.q6: How does reputation work in Regálalo?
faq.a6: Every time you hand something over or confirm a pick-up, the community gets to know you a little better. The more you give, the more visible you are and the easier it is for donors to choose you when you request something. If you commit to picking up an item and don't show up, points are deducted: −10 the first time, −20 the second, and −30 the third. Completing a handoff resets the counter. If you keep requesting without donating for months, your candidacy will appear lower — or stop showing to donors — until you complete a donation.
faq.q7: Is Regálalo safe? How is my privacy protected?
faq.a7: Yes. The donor's contact details are only shared once the handoff is confirmed, and are automatically deleted after 7 days. Before that point, no one sees the other person's personal information. There is no internal messaging: the agreement is finalised at the moment of the handoff.
faq.q8: How many items can I request per month?
faq.a8: You can request up to 3 items per month. There is no monthly limit for publishing items to give away.

header.title: Your reputation
header.lede_before: Your reputation reflects what you contribute to the community.
header.lede_strong: The more you give, the easier it is to receive.
header.lede_after: Here we explain step by step what adds points, what takes points off, and what happens to your place on the list when donors choose who to give to.

start.body: You don't need anything to join. Your reputation rises when you take part. If you commit to pick something up and don't go, points can go down —even below zero—, but you can always earn them back by giving or completing handoffs.

gain.title: How to earn points
gain.sub: Taking part is what builds your reputation. There are three ways to add points, and giving always counts the most.

first.name: Your first donation
first.desc: The first time you hand an item to someone, you get an extra boost to start on the right foot.

next.name: Each donation after that
next.desc: Every time you give something again and the handoff is completed, your reputation goes up again.

receive.name: Receiving an item
receive.desc: When you pick up something you've been given and the handoff is completed, you also gain one point.

lose.title: When points go down
lose.sub_before: It only happens in one situation:
lose.sub_strong: committing to pick up an item and not showing up.
lose.sub_after: When someone sets something aside for you and you don't go, they're left waiting. If it happens again without a handoff in between, a few more points come off each time.

first.strong: The first time you don't show up
first.body: to pick up an item, 10 points come off.

stairs.caption: If it happens again before you complete a handoff, a little more comes off each time.

first.note: You don't show up to pick up.

second.note: It happens again without completing any handoff.

third.note: And so on — a bit more with each repeat, until you complete a handoff.

reset.strong: A completed handoff resets the counter.
reset.body: When you give or receive again and the handoff is confirmed, you start fresh. If you don't show up next time, you lose 10 points —same as the first time—, not more until you complete another handoff.

visibility.title: What happens if you don't give
visibility.sub_before: Regálalo works because people give and receive. If you only ask for a long time and never give anything, gradually
visibility.sub_after: when they choose who to deliver to.

one_month.headline: You appear lower on the list
one_month.desc: When a donor looks at who requested their item, you're still there, but lower down. People who also give to the community appear ahead of you.

two_months.headline: Your request isn't shown to donors
two_months.desc: If two months pass and you still haven't given anything, your request stops appearing on donors' lists when they choose a recipient.

restore.strong: A single donation brings you back right away.
restore.body: As soon as you give something, you appear normally to donors again, no matter how long you hadn't given anything.

closing.sub: Give what you don't need and your reputation will take care of you.

meta.title: Your reputation on Regálalo — Points system
meta.description: Learn how reputation works on Regálalo: earn points by donating, find out what happens if you don't show up, and how your history affects your position in the list.

faq.q1: How do you earn reputation on Regálalo?
faq.a1: You earn +15 points for your first donation, +10 points for each subsequent completed donation, and +1 point each time you receive an item and complete the pick-up. Giving always counts for more than receiving.
faq.q2: When do reputation points go down on Regálalo?
faq.a2: Points go down if you commit to picking up an item and don't show up: −10 the first time, −20 the second, −30 the third and beyond. Completing a handoff resets the counter.
faq.q3: What happens if I only request items but never donate anything?
faq.a3: After a month of requesting without donating, you appear lower on the list. After two months, your request stops showing to donors. A single completed donation brings you back to normal instantly.
